import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the escaped content. BLOG_FORMAT: str = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe HTML rendering. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Raises ------ TypeError If either ``heading`` or ``description`` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError(f"Expected heading to be a string, got {type(heading).__name__}") if not isinstance(description, str): raise TypeError(f"Expected description to be a string, got {type(description).__name__}") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection (CWE‑74). safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the predefined format. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description)
